glosses: a metric pound, 500 grams, half a kilogram
any of the English (Anglophone) units of mass or currency called a "pound"
a hard shot at the goal

examples.text: Ich möchte ein paar Pfunde loswerden.
examples.en: I'd like to lose a few pounds.

examples.text: Hier wird Fisch im Pfund verkauft.
examples.en: Fish is sold by the pound here.

examples.text: Ich habe drei Pfund Kaffee gekauft.
examples.en: I bought three pounds of coffee.
How many pounds do you weigh?
